from.place: Lemma 4.2.9 local computation: the polynomial quotient presentation of a distinguished blowup chart and its ratio coordinates.

title: Polynomial quotient ring of a parameter blowup chart
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $d\geq0$ an integer, $t=(t_i)_{i\in\{1,\ldots,d\}}$ a family in $R$, $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}$ and $j\in\{1,\ldots,d\}$. Put $L=J\setminus\{j\}$ and let $B=R[u_i\mid i\in L]$ be the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Define $r_i=t_i-t_j u_i\in B$ for $i\in L$, $I=(r_i\mid i\in L)\subseteq B$, and the commutative $R$-algebra $A_j=B/I$ with its inherited quotient ring structure and coefficient map $R\to B\to A_j$. For every $i\in L$, its ratio coordinate is the image of $u_i$ under $B\to A_j$. These definitions also apply when $L$ is empty, in which case $B=R$, $I=0$ and $A_j=R$.
